proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3103 kāleyaka expressly discusses the heart/liver semantic overlap and gives Hindi karejā heart/liver, Assamese kɔlizā heart and Gujarati kāḷjũ heart/liver. The survey kalja/kaleja/kareja heart words fit this explicitly documented sense family. Exact survey form kaljo is preserved.
